churches.assessment: Ascension Presbyterian Church is an Orthodox Presbyterian Church congregation in Birmingham, Alabama, in the Presbytery of the South. The church meets at East 59 Cafe in the Doug Baker Blvd corridor — a sign of an active church plant or recently established congregation in the south Birmingham metro. Rev. Luke Gossett serves as Pastor. As OPC, the church subscribes strictly to the Westminster Standards, holds to male-only ordination, and operates under presbytery accountability. For a man wanting strict-subscription Reformed worship in the Birmingham area, Ascension OPC offers confessional accountability uncommon in the city's Baptist-dominated landscape.

churches.assessment: Briarwood Presbyterian Church at 2200 Briarwood Way, Birmingham, AL 35243. PCA megachurch. Dr. Harry L. Reeder III served as senior pastor until his death in a traffic accident in May 2023. Rev. Dan Doriani (Covenant Theological Seminary professor) began serving as interim pastor in December 2023. Briarwood is one of the largest PCA congregations in America with strong Reformed theology, missions engagement, and community impact. Currently in pastoral transition — evaluate who the next permanent pastor will be.

pastor_transition.detail: Scott Redd installed as senior pastor Aug 10, 2025 after a nationwide search, succeeding Harry Reeder III (died May 2023; Dan Doriani served as interim). Handoff is complete; Redd is current.

churches.assessment: Christ Methodist Church of Auburn is a post-2022 Global Methodist plant, having voted to join the GMC and called Dr. Tony McCullough as their first senior minister in 2023. Nearly 700 members stood together at their first membership vows ceremony. The congregation currently gathers at the Greystone Office and Ministry Center while actively exploring permanent building options. As a GMC church, they affirm orthodox Wesleyan theology, traditional marriage, and the historic Christian faith — the specific reasons the GMC separated from the progressive UMC. Male lead pastor, active men's Bible study, and children's ministry make this a strong Methodist option for the Auburn area. The one caution flag is that the GMC's Alabama-Florida-West Georgia Conference ordination stance on women as elders should be verified; GMC varies by conference. Overall a green-eligible, solidly orthodox Wesleyan church worth further on-the-ground review.

churches.assessment: Covenant Methodist Church of Dothan, Alabama was founded in 1979 by Pastor B. Michael Watson and joined the Global Methodist Church on May 8, 2023. Current Senior Pastor Rev. Kyle Gatlin leads an impressively developed ministry structure: CovKids (children), CovStudents (youth), CovMen (men's ministry), CovGroups (small groups), plus women's, recreation, and missions programs. The church maintains an active podcast and online worship presence. This is one of the most fully-developed GMC congregations profiled here — visible men's ministry and kids ministry, strong mission focus, clear institutional orthodox commitment. The GMC Alabama-West Florida Conference stance on women elders should still be verified. Overall a strong green-eligible Wesleyan option in southeast Alabama.

churches.assessment: Mennonite Christian Fellowship (MCF) — the namesake congregation of the small conservative Anabaptist denomination — is located in Atmore, Alabama. The MCF denomination originated in 1958 from early Amish revivalist groups in Holmes County, Ohio, and now numbers approximately 34 congregations and 1,500+ members nationwide. MCF practices plain dress, women's head covering, plural minister polity (bishop/minister/deacon), male-only ordination, and adheres to the Dordrecht Confession. The denomination publishes The Fellowship Contributor monthly. The Atmore congregation streams Sunday worship live on YouTube at 10:30 AM. Green rating reflects strong confessional, gender, leadership, and cultural integrity.
